name: ai-tidu9-workspace
description: 九门赛博提督·智能协作中枢

scripts.tidu:setup: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && npm install --no-package-lock && npm run build:tidu && exec node scripts/dev-tidu.mjs'
scripts.tidu:dev-frontend-p: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-frontend-p'
scripts.tidu:dev-frontend-e: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-frontend-e'
scripts.tidu:dev-cli-p: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-cli-p'
scripts.tidu:dev-cli-e: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-cli-e'
scripts.tidu:dev-api-p: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-api-p'
scripts.tidu:dev-api-e: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && exec node packages/tidu/dist/cli/launcher.js service start tidu:dev-api-e'
scripts.check: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && npm run policy -- versions && npm run lint && npm test'
scripts.test: sh -c '. ./scripts/use-project-node.sh && node --test --test-reporter=dot scripts/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present && python3 -m unittest discover -s sdk/python/tests'
